label: Surveying study, 1987; geodetic research from 1995
basis: Paul Denys completed a Master of Surveying at Otago in 1987 and joined its School of Surveying in June 1995. His work addressed GPS networks, deformation and reference systems. In 2013 he co-authored the PositioNZ-PP online GPS-processing application account with C. Pearson, Chris Crook and A. Jordan.

sources.label: University of Otago, Paul H. Denys: career history and 2013 PositioNZ-PP publication
